root.label: ASIC home insurance cash settlement review

events.label: ASIC home insurance cash settlement review

slots.name: final claims cash share
slots.sentence: Cash settlements were used in more than 63% of final claims.

slots.name: IAG Allianz cash share
slots.sentence: IAG and Allianz each used full or partial cash settlements in more than 80% of cases.

slots.name: preferred builder discount
slots.sentence: Most cash settlement offers were based on just one quote and most of those were from insurers’ preferred suppliers, the review found.

slots.name: insurers lacking disclosure
slots.sentence: Insurers rarely provided consumers enough information to determine if cash was their best option.

slots.name: vulnerable insurer approaches
slots.sentence: Three insurers did not tell consumers their policies permitted them to change their mind after accepting cash settlements, though two later told Asic they had begun clearly informing consumers of their rights.

slots.name: case builder discount
slots.sentence: In one case, an insurer’s preferred builder provided a quote at a 40% discount and the insurer paid out that cheaper quote in cash.

slots.name: flawed vulnerable customer identification
slots.sentence: Four of the five insurers had flawed approaches for identifying and assisting vulnerable customers, the report found.

slots.name: average annual extreme weather claims
slots.sentence: In a 2025 report, it estimated extreme weather had generated $4.5bn worth of claims each year on average in the 2020s.
